Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Stay connected, motivated, and in control with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch. Designed for everyday performance, it combines a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display with essential health insights, fitness tracking, and Bluetooth calling—all in one sleek, modern wearable.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for sharp, vivid viewing
- Bluetooth calling for convenient communication on the go
- Up to 7-day battery life for reliable daily use
- Heart-rate monitoring to help track your wellness
- Sleep tracking for better rest insights
- IP68 waterproof design for everyday durability
- Fitness activity tracking to support your active lifestyle

Promotional Tagline:
Smart style. Smarter tracking. Everyday performance.
